methods.grid: masked uniform cell raster, 0..100 relative height (not meters), raw height based on distance from polygon shoreline and inland ridge candidate axis
methods.conditioning: Priority-flood from every coast-adjacent cell, directed downslope parent relation with strict tie epsilon
methods.routing: D8 adjacency and upslope cell accumulation counted over every land cell
methods.water_channels: Up to five model paths per region obtained by tracing strongest upstream contributor of coast outlet; examples not actual rivers
methods.required_next: Later validate relative terrain against tectonics, rainfall and signed-off world canon before accepting rivers and physical heights

technical_limits: Cells are drawn in work SVG coordinate units, not real physical kilometers or WGS84
Elevation and flow are constructed geometrically, not real orbital/planetographic data
Priority-flood corrections are scenario artifacts, not proven natural lakes or streams
Flowlines cannot cross water or link across candidate islands
The core supercontinent model is not a coordinate model of canon Resistance Arc, Tangxi, R1 or R2
